source: National Archives Amendments 11–27 transcript, Amendment XV Section 1
review_notes: Codex reviewed the full voting-rights clause. Race, color, and previous condition of servitude are three distinct forbidden grounds; denial and abridgment by both federal and State actors are separately labeled. The standalone excerpt repeats the amendment heading for source attribution. These are Codex labels, not independent human labels.
text:
AMENDMENT XV
Section 1.
The right of citizens of the United States to vote shall not be denied or abridged by the United States or by any State on account of race, color, or previous condition of servitude--
